name: adonis-telescope-server
description: A central Telescope server for AdonisJS apps: every app sends its Telescope entries to one server, and the console shows them per app. Part of the Agora ecosystem.
author: Davi Carvalho <davi_carvalho96@hotmail.com>

scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && biome check --write .
scripts.release: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && pnpm --filter './packages/*' build && changeset publish
